CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cloud_players (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, name TEXT NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cloud_sessions (token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cloud_players(id), expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS cloud_sessions_expiry ON cloud_sessions(expires_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cloud_saves (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cloud_players(id), game_slug TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS cloud_saves_owner ON cloud_saves(user_id, game_slug, deleted, updated_at)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cloud_schema (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO cloud_schema (id, version) VALUES (1, 1) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET version = excluded.version
